meta.name: datamol
meta.description: Pythonic wrapper around RDKit with simplified interface and sensible defaults. Preferred for standard drug discovery including SMILES parsing, standardization, descriptors, fingerprints, clustering, 3D conformers, parallel processing. Returns native rdkit.Chem.Mol objects. For advanced control or custom parameters, use rdkit directly.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline_en: Simplify molecular analysis in drug research and development

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 datamol 处理分子数据:解析与标准化 SMILES、计算描述符和指纹、做聚类与多样性挑选、生成 3D 构象,并支持批量并行。返回原生 RDKit Mol 对象。
howto.when: 当你需要做常规药物发现里的分子计算,比如解析或标准化 SMILES、算描述符与指纹、聚类等时会用它;若需要更细的参数控制,原文建议直接用 rdkit。

howto.what_en: Claude uses datamol to work with molecules: parse and standardize SMILES, compute descriptors and fingerprints, cluster and pick diverse sets, and generate 3D conformers, with batch parallel processing. It returns native RDKit Mol objects.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need standard drug-discovery molecule work, like parsing or standardizing SMILES, computing descriptors and fingerprints, and similar. For advanced control or custom parameters, use rdkit directly.
